title: Henrik Mitsch on Lenny's Podcast with Eric Ries
summary: VP Digital at Elli (and a 2013 Leancamp London attendee who met Eric in person) listens to the podcast and posts a reflection on LinkedIn.
blockquote: The latest episode of Lenny's Podcast with Eric Ries is amazing. They talk about Eric's new book „Incorruptible“. Eric shares some eye-opening (and fun) stories about how companies manage to stay great over time rather than being corrupted into mediocrity by their own success.
